I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from #central-random, a channel Pree is in. Yesterday (13 Oct, 9:27) Tobias posted that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he had flagged it for support on #8841.

His message didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I linked it to that account because he was answering Hollis's question about his dealer account. The Central handoff digest shows Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and was due to change hands on 5 Jan; that it went to Tobias is my inference. A ticket number isn't a finance figure, and Pree could already see the message, so no approval was needed to share it.
